<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Declare a disposition policy version"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/disposition-policies/{version}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Declares policy version `version` (any positive integer; the service
does not require it to be current + 1, and the declared version
becomes the current one). The table maps
(grade, productClass) to an outcome; the entry `productClass: "*"` is
the required default per grade, which makes `Decide` total. Also
carries the return window days, the max units per line and the
`vetoOutcome` a guardrail demotion falls back to (default DISPOSE).
An `outcome` outside the five values is 400 `invalid-policy`, a grade
outside A/B/C/SCRAP 400 `invalid-grade`. `returnWindowDays` defaults to
0 when omitted. The 409 of this operation is `idempotency-key-reused`.
Requires an `Idempotency-Key`.
